entrySkills.name: lumo-start-here
entrySkills.primaryFor: new, mixed, or factual requests with no clear lifecycle phase
entrySkills.notFor: a request already owned by one lifecycle entry

entrySkills.name: lumo-build-and-env
entrySkills.primaryFor: fresh clone, machine, prerequisites, or never-provisioned environment
entrySkills.notFor: a previously working environment that regressed

entrySkills.name: braze-solution-demo-campaign
entrySkills.primaryFor: unapproved evidence, screenshots, Canvas mapping, or demo-scope selection

entrySkills.name: lumo-new-demo-campaign
entrySkills.primaryFor: approved end-to-end or focused demo implementation

entrySkills.name: lumo-run-and-operate
entrySkills.primaryFor: ordinary readiness, launch, rehearsal, and presentation of an existing demo
entrySkills.notFor: missing setup, missing story, or a confirmed regression

entrySkills.name: lumo-debugging-playbook
entrySkills.primaryFor: a capability proven on this machine, install, and workspace that now fails
entrySkills.notFor: a prerequisite or push path that has never worked

entrySkills.name: lumo-push-readiness-campaign
entrySkills.primaryFor: first end-to-end Android push proof for a teammate or workspace
entrySkills.notFor: push previously proven on the same install and workspace

entrySkills.name: lumo-secrets-and-sanitization
entrySkills.primaryFor: credential, private-material, sanitization, handoff, or secret-incident work
entrySkills.notFor: an ordinary commit with no sensitive-material concern

entrySkills.name: lumo-change-control-and-qa
entrySkills.primaryFor: validation, commit, push, PR, release, sharing, or handoff boundary
entrySkills.notFor: ordinary implementation before a delivery boundary

Add one approved Content Card surface to this existing demo.
Create the neutral pack for this already approved story.
Start the Control Room and run my demo.
Rehearse the approved story and verify ordinary readiness.
Switch the active pack and launch Android without resetting identity.

Push worked yesterday but stopped arriving on this emulator.
Android push has never worked for this teammate's workspace.
Safely hand off the Firebase service account outside Git.
